about: The draw key's scenes (tools/port/oracle/gen.py draw; docs/bevy/M3A_NOTES.md §1). A cmd is a debug command queued before frame 0 or [frame, cmd]; frames use stubs-draw.c's DRAW_FRAMES grammar (a, a-b, a-b/k); viewport is [w, h, dpr]; named labels frame ranges.

fixed_inputs.viewport: per scene (DRAW_W / DRAW_H / DRAW_DPR -> pf_width / pf_height / pf_density); DPR 1 everywhere
fixed_inputs.msaa_samples: 1 (the stub's r_sample_count, so fu[157] = 0.5: render.lisp FILL-FRAME-UNIFORMS)
fixed_inputs.render_scale: 1 (*render-scale*; r_timing returns 0, so the auto scale never moves it)
fixed_inputs.page: pf_page_get 0 for every key: a desktop window with nothing saved, so *coarse* NIL, *one-hand* NIL, *scene-scale-cap* 1 (onehand.lisp)
fixed_inputs.dt: raw_dt from tools/simgate/stubs.c pf_pump: frame n's raw dt = (floor(n * 50/3 ms * 1e6) - floor((n-1) * 50/3 ms * 1e6)) * 1e-9f, so it alternates by 1 ns around 1/60 s
fixed_inputs.rng: rng_float (engine/c/rng.c rng_state) runs from its seed 0x9E3779B9 at load; each scene records its state at the first pf_pump (rng_start) and at each keyed r_frame
fixed_inputs.match_seed: per scene (INDEX match_seed: [frame, *match-seed*] at frame 0 and at each change)
fixed_inputs.hud_font: the real atlas (duel/hud-font/atlas.r8 + metrics.bin through .incbin), so hb / hk are what the browser gets

commands.2005: debug.lisp 2000+s: seeded CPU vs CPU (gate.lisp START-CVC seed 5, NORMAL), both fighters drawn from the seed over the playable roster: ICHIGO vs KENPACHI; the intro and every mid-match cinematic played
commands.2394: debug.lisp STRING-TEST k (2394+k): human P1 in form k (0 Ichigo :base (the Shikai), 1 Ichigo :kessa, 2 Kenpachi :base (sealed), 3 Kenpachi :nozarashi (the Shikai)) 2.2 m from an idle Kenpachi (ENSURE-BATTLE: VS CPU, P2 brain off); natively no script presses
commands.2500: debug.lisp 2500+k: human P1 vs an idle CPU P2 (brain off), *match-seed* 1, VS CPU, cinematics skipped (START-MATCH under *skip-cines*): 0 Ichigo vs Kenpachi, 1 Kenpachi vs Ichigo, 2 Ichigo vs Ichigo, 3 Kenpachi vs Kenpachi. Natively no input reaches P1, so both stand
commands.2505: debug.lisp LHUD-SCENE: human Ichigo (P1) vs Kenpachi with his CPU off, cinematics skipped, VS CPU (one-handed only where in effect: not here, pf_page_get 0)
commands.2508: debug.lisp LHUD-P2-FORM: P2 Kenpachi to his next form: sealed -> the Shikai (KAIHO L2) -> the Bankai KYORAN -> ZANKAI -> sealed
